page_title: INT 3-0 FIO | Inter v Fiorentina 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90+2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Lautaro Martinez will be replaced by Luis Henrique (Inter).
89' Substitution. Alessandro Bastoni makes his way off the pitch and Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes on as his replacement.
88' 3 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper David de Gea no chance!
88' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

86' Mattia Viti (Fiorentina) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Simone Sozza shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.
85' Nicolo Barella will be replaced by Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
83' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Yann Sommer, who pulls off a decent save!
81' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) sends a wild header high over the bar.
81' Fiorentina force a corner. They send men into the box.
80' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' Stefano Pioli is forced to make a change. Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is unable to continue due to injury, Niccolo Fortini comes on.
78' Substitution. Carlos Augusto (Inter) has come on for Denzel Dumfries.
78' A substitution has been made. Francesco Pio Esposito is replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
76' Stefano Pioli prepares a substitution. Rolando Mandragora is replaced by Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina).
75' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is caught offside!
74' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Dodo (Fiorentina), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles past the right post. Poor effort.
71' 2 - 0 Petar Sucic (Inter) gets in a good position after an exceptional individual run and releases a powerful shot that flies precisely into the bottom left corner.
68' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.

66' 1 - 0 Nicolo Barella slides a pass towards Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner. The score is now 1:0.
65' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
62' Stefano Pioli has decided to substitute Albert Gudmundsson and he is replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina).
62' That will be all from Simon Sohm who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina).
61' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
57' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
57' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.
57' Yann Bisseck (Inter) produces a good strike towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
56' Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.

56' Unbelievable! Denzel Dumfries (Inter) wastes a huge scoring opportunity! He finds himself unmarked right in front of goal and fires in a first-time shot. David de Gea pulls off one of the best saves of his career and stops the effort from hitting the net.
55' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Inter! Play can continue.
55' There's a break in play and referee Simone Sozza must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Inter using VAR. This could be interesting!
54' One of the Inter players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
54' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

53' Federico Dimarco (Inter) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
49' The foul by Mattia Viti (Fiorentina) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Simone Sozza.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
38' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
35' Federico Dimarco (Inter) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but David de Gea was alert and made an amazing save!
33' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
30' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
27' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
26' Now Inter have a corner.
26' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
20' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
19' Dodo (Fiorentina) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
19' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

19' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
15' Inter fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
11' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
10' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
7' Petar Sucic (Inter) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
6' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.

6' Mattia Viti (Fiorentina) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simone Sozza no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Inter.
5' Inter control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) touches the ball with his hand.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Fiorentina will kick the game off.
Simone Sozza will referee today's match.
